title: claude-neoize structural graph
description: The output shape a project collector (.neoize/collect.py) writes to .neoize/graph.json. It is a projection of the code, regenerated and never hand-edited. The sibling .neoize/graph.cypher is the MERGE form loaded into Neo4j; keep both in sync.

label.description: The node label, a domain entity kind (Module, Service, Route, Entity, ...). Chosen for THIS project, not generic.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the label. A lesson anchors to {type: label, id: id}.

props.description: Flat scalar properties (Neo4j has no nested node maps).

type.description: Relationship type, a verb the project reasons along (DEPENDS_ON, IMPLEMENTS, GRANTS, CALLS, ...).

counts.description: Optional node/edge counts the collector prints; informational.
